text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps the team track progress and stay motivated along the way. Deliverables should be clearly defined so everyone knows what needs to be completed and when. It is also important to ensure stakeholder alignment, meaning all key people agree on the objectives from the start. When goals are well planned and everyone is on the same page, projects are more likely to finish on time and meet expectations.
